articles.title: Apple, Meta reject OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans, leaving crypto firms as the ones to watch
articles.snippet: Strategy, Coinbase, Circle and Robinhood are among six companies from the venture’s initial selection with no disclosed objection, after 90% of issuers opted out.

articles.title: The crypto industry has found new ways to grow. Making money from them is another story
articles.snippet: Coinbase, Robinhood and Circle are expanding into stablecoins, payments and prediction markets, but their latest earnings show how hard it is to escape crypto's boom-and-bust cycles.

articles.title: Greece approves 10% tax on crypto gains and 15% levy on DeFi income
articles.snippet: Investors will have 12 months to declare past crypto gains without late-filing penalties, though questions remain over crypto-to-crypto swaps.

articles.title: Ukraine’s central bank opposes crypto bill, citing monetary sovereignty concerns
articles.snippet: Ukraine’s central bank won’t back a crypto legalization bill in its current form and wants lawmakers to revise it before a final vote.

articles.title: Mercado Bitcoin Said Its Hack Was Contained, But Blockchain Data Tells a Different Story
articles.snippet: Fresh forensic analysis traces $48.6 million across 11 blockchains and finds thousands of customer deposit addresses drained hours after the Brazilian exchange said it had stopped the breach on Monday.
